text.body:
Abhidhānottaratantra ch. 30 [Tib. & Ś. 33]
= Lokesh Chandra facsimile ed.
= 1138 AD palm-leaf codex
[ 1195]
athānyaṃ sampravakṣ[y]āmi buddhaḍākavidhikramaṃ |
pūrvoktabuddhaḍākena āgamādikrameṣu ca |
āgamo na vinā (!) yogī buddhakolo bhaviṣyati | (= buddhakaulo!)
na tyajed āgamāṃ nītiṃ na tyajec ca triratnajāṃ |
buddhe dharme ca saṃghe ca śaraṇaṃ gacchāmi nityaśaḥ |
prajñā[ 120]pāramitāvalaṃbya yogasiddhis tu sidhyati |
jhaṭitākārayogena ātmadehaṃ vicintayet |
nīlogravikṛtaṃ raudraṃ bhayasyāpi bhayaṅkaraṃ |
draṃṣṭrākarālavadanaṃ jaṭābaddhenduśekharaṃ |
viśvavajrajaṭābhāraṃ kapālair mālabhūṣitaṃ |
sarvālaṅkārasampūrṇā ṣaṇmudrādehajaṃ baṃ hūṃ ||
vyāghracarmanivasanaṃ | ardhaparyaṅkasusthitaṃ |
trinetraṃ raudravapusaṃ caturgrīvaṃ caturmukhaṃ |
bhujadvādaśabhir yuktaṃ śūnyatājñānam uttamaṃ ||
sarvaduṣṭaśiromālā sragdāmaṃ pralayodbhavaṃ |
sarvaduṣṭapadākrāntaṃ kleśabhairavayor mukhaṃ |
tṛṣṇāmohagatā īrṣyā kālarātryām adhomukhā ||
pādatalagatāḥ sarve vighnā duṣṭabhayānakāḥ |
gaganagauraṃ sitaraktaṃ harita mūrdhnānanaṃ parā |
vajraghaṇṭāsamāpannā vārāhyāliṅgaṇaṃ mukhaṃ(!) |
samatādvayayogena sarvadharmaika[ 120]rasatayā nāma dhutaguṇaṃ śrīmahāsukhavajraherukaṃ |
kapālakhaṭvāṅgadharaṃ dharmacakrajharjharaṃ pātraṃ śūlapāśāṅkuśakaraṃ muṇḍaṃ ca ḍamaruṃ tathā |
vāmadakṣiṇapāṇibhyāṃ naracarmapaṭordhvakaṃ ||
pūrve tu mātaṅgī ḍombikā caiva raja[kī] pukkasī tathā |
khaṭṭikī śāvarī caiva dhīvarī śavarī tathā |
etāṣṭau devīnāṃ yathānukramato nyaset ||
pītā nīlā tathā raktā dhūmradhūsara[varṇajā |]
raktaharitā dhūmravarṇā sitāṣṭamī tathā |
dvāreṣu ca tathā nyastā krodhaḍākinikās tathā |
herukābhā vajracaṇḍī ca vajrarākṣasīkottamā |
vajrabhairavikā raudrāṃ sarvadurdāntabhakṣikāṃ |
bhasmaśubh[r]ā ca haritā raktanīlograbhīṣaṇāṃ |
madhye cāṣṭau dharmacakrajharjharakapālaḍamaruka[r]ttikāḥ |
skandhopari cīvaradharāṃ |
dvāreṣu caturo devyā
kapālakhaṭvāṅgābhayacarmajharjharaḍama[ 121]rukā ||
ekavaktrā caturbhujā pretāsanopari ardhaparyaṅkanṛtyapade sthitāḥ [|]
peṇḍipātikāḥ traicīvarikāḥ paścātkhalubhaktikāḥ | naiṣadikāḥ [|] yathāsa[ṃ]starikāḥ | ekāsanikāḥ | abhyavakāsikāḥ | vṛkṣamūlikāḥ | araṇyavāsikāḥ | śmaśānikāḥ | pānsukūlikāḥ | nāma[n]trikāḥ | iti yathākrameṇa viśuddhito dhutaguṇā bhāvyāḥ | jñānasamayasa[ma]yottamaikarasatāṃ bhāvyā |
oṃ śrī mahāsukhavajra he he ru ru kaṃ āḥ hūṃ 2 phaṭ svāhā ||
oṃ māṃ mātaṅgī hūṃ 2 phaṭ svāhā |
oṃ ḍoṃ vajradombī hūṃ 2 phaṭ |
oṃ raṃ rajakī hūṃ 2 phaṭ |
oṃ puṃ pukkasī hūṃ 2 phaṭ |
oṃ khaṃ khaṭṭikī hūṃ 2 phaṭ |
oṃ sāṃ sāvarī hūṃ 2 phaṭ ||
oṃ dhī dhīvarī hūṃ 2 phaṭ |
oṃ heṃ saṃ savarī hūṃ 2 phaṭ |
oṃ heṃ herukī hūṃ 2 phaṭ ||
oṃ caṃ vajracaṇḍī hūṃ 2 phaṭ |
oṃ rāṃ vajrarākṣasī hūṃ 2 phaṭ ||
oṃ bheṃ bhairavī hūṃ 2 phaṭ ||
etā [ 121] sarvā nagnā muktakeśāḥ trinetrāḥ [|]
saumyadraṣṭrā karālānanā pañcamudrālaṅkārabhūṣitadehāḥ |
kapālamālāmakuṭī [|]
hasitaśāntaśṛṅgārādbhutavīrabībhatsaraudrākrodharasā |
jāpabhāvanāsphuraṇasaṃharaṇakāyavākcittaviharaṇa viharet | nānādhimuktisattvavinayopāyasukhāhlādanaviṣayaparibhogānuttarajñānaphalāptitvāt sattvānāṃ tena mukhonumukhāmṛtaparibhogājñānāvāptiphalalabdānāṃ ((iti)) varalabdapadaṃ sarvasattvānāṃ |
Abhidhānottar<|e|><o>ttare dhutaguṇotpattipaṭala[s] triṃśatimaḥ || o || [ 1214']
